description: Chapter summaries the reader shows under a chapter's title, keyed by chapter number, per language. Like section headings they are editorial aids, not translation: written from Open Word Bible's own wording, stating what the chapter is about and nothing more, so every language can say the same thing. They use no reader settings. Every summary is an AI draft until a named reviewer approves it.

1.en: After the death of Moses, God commissions Joshua to lead Israel across the Jordan and promises to be with him; he must be strong and courageous and keep the law. Reuben, Gad and half of Manasseh agree to cross and fight with the other tribes.
1.sw: Baada ya kifo cha Musa, Mungu anamwagiza Yoshua awaongoze Israeli kuvuka Yordani na kuahidi kuwa pamoja naye; anapaswa kuwa hodari na mwenye moyo mkuu na kuishika sheria. Reubeni, Gadi na nusu ya kabila la Manase wanakubali kuvuka na kupigana pamoja na makabila mengine.
1.am: ከሙሴ ሞት በኋላ እግዚአብሔር እስራኤልን ዮርዳኖስን አሻግሮ እንዲመራ ኢያሱን ያዝዘዋል፤ ከእርሱም ጋር እንደሚሆን ተስፋ ይሰጠዋል፤ ኢያሱ ብርቱና ደፋር ሆኖ ሕጉን መጠበቅ አለበት። ሮቤል፣ ጋድና የምናሴ ነገድ እኩሌታ ተሻግረው ከሌሎቹ ነገዶች ጋር ለመዋጋት ይስማማሉ።

2.en: Joshua sends two spies to Jericho, where Rahab hides them from the king's men because she has heard what God has done. The spies promise to spare her family if she ties a scarlet cord in her window.
2.sw: Yoshua anawatuma wapelelezi wawili Yeriko, ambapo Rahabu anawaficha wasionekane na watu wa mfalme kwa sababu amesikia yale ambayo Mungu ametenda. Wapelelezi wanaahidi kuiacha hai jamaa yake ikiwa atafunga kamba nyekundu dirishani mwake.
2.am: ኢያሱ ሁለት ሰላዮችን ወደ ኢያሪኮ ይልካል፤ በዚያም ረዓብ እግዚአብሔር ያደረገውን ስለ ሰማች ከንጉሡ ሰዎች ትሸሽጋቸዋለች። ሰላዮቹም በመስኮቷ ላይ ቀይ ገመድ ካሰረች ቤተ ሰቧን እንደሚያተርፉ ቃል ይገቡላታል።

3.en: The priests carry the ark of the covenant into the Jordan, and the river stops flowing so that Israel crosses on dry ground.
3.sw: Makuhani wanalibeba sanduku la agano kuingia ndani ya Yordani, na mto unaacha kutiririka ili Israeli wavuke katika nchi kavu.
3.am: ካህናቱ የቃል ኪዳኑን ታቦት ተሸክመው ወደ ዮርዳኖስ ይገባሉ፤ እስራኤልም በደረቅ ምድር እንዲሻገሩ ወንዙ መፍሰሱን ያቆማል።

4.en: Twelve men take twelve stones from the riverbed to set up as a memorial at Gilgal. When the priests come out of the Jordan, the waters return.
4.sw: Wanaume kumi na wawili wanachukua mawe kumi na mawili kutoka katikati ya mto ili kuyasimamisha kama ukumbusho huko Gilgali. Makuhani wanapotoka ndani ya Yordani, maji yanarudi.
4.am: አሥራ ሁለት ሰዎች በጌልገላ መታሰቢያ አድርገው ሊያቆሙ ከወንዙ ወለል አሥራ ሁለት ድንጋዮችን ይወስዳሉ። ካህናቱ ከዮርዳኖስ በወጡ ጊዜ ውኆቹ ይመለሳሉ።

5.en: The kings of Canaan lose heart. Israel is circumcised at Gilgal and keeps the Passover, the manna stops, and Joshua meets the commander of God's army.
5.sw: Wafalme wa Kanaani wanakata tamaa. Israeli wanatahiriwa huko Gilgali na kuadhimisha Pasaka, mana inakoma, na Yoshua anakutana na mkuu wa jeshi la Mungu.
5.am: የከነዓን ነገሥታት ልባቸው ይቀልጣል። እስራኤል በጌልገላ ይገረዛሉ፤ ፋሲካንም ያከብራሉ፤ መናው ይቋረጣል፤ ኢያሱም ከእግዚአብሔር ሠራዊት አለቃ ጋር ይገናኛል።

6.en: Israel marches around Jericho for seven days, the priests blow the horns, the people shout, and the wall falls down. The city is devoted to destruction, and Rahab and her family are spared.
6.sw: Israeli wanauzunguka Yeriko kwa siku saba, makuhani wanapiga pembe, watu wanapiga kelele, na ukuta unaanguka. Mji unawekwa wakfu kwa maangamizi, na Rahabu na jamaa yake wanaachwa hai.
6.am: እስራኤል ለሰባት ቀናት ኢያሪኮን ይዞራሉ፤ ካህናቱ ቀንደ መለከት ይነፋሉ፤ ሕዝቡ ይጮኻል፤ ቅጥሩም ይፈርሳል። ከተማዋ ለጥፋት ትለያለች፤ ረዓብና ቤተ ሰቧም ይተርፋሉ።

7.en: Israel is defeated at Ai because Achan took some of the devoted things from Jericho. Achan is found out by lot and put to death with his household in the Valley of Achor.
7.sw: Israeli wanashindwa huko Ai kwa sababu Akani alichukua baadhi ya vitu vilivyowekwa wakfu kutoka Yeriko. Akani anagunduliwa kwa kura na kuuawa pamoja na watu wa nyumbani mwake katika Bonde la Akori.
7.am: አካን ከኢያሪኮ ለጥፋት ከተለዩት ነገሮች አንዳንዱን ስለ ወሰደ እስራኤል በጋይ ይሸነፋሉ። አካን በዕጣ ይገለጣል፤ ከቤተ ሰቡም ጋር በአኮር ሸለቆ ይገደላል።

8.en: Israel sets an ambush and takes Ai. Joshua builds an altar on Mount Ebal, writes a copy of the law on stones, and reads the blessings and curses to all the people.
8.sw: Israeli wanaweka mtego na kuuteka Ai. Yoshua anajenga madhabahu katika Mlima Ebali, anaandika nakala ya sheria juu ya mawe, na kuwasomea watu wote baraka na laana.
8.am: እስራኤል ድብቅ ጦር አዘጋጅተው ጋይን ይይዛሉ። ኢያሱ በጌባል ተራራ ላይ መሠዊያ ይሠራል፤ የሕጉን ቅጂ በድንጋዮች ላይ ይጽፋል፤ በረከቱንና እርግማኑንም ለሕዝቡ ሁሉ ያነብባል።

9.en: The Gibeonites trick Israel into a treaty by pretending to come from a far country. When the deception is found out, they are spared but made woodcutters and water carriers.
9.sw: Wagibeoni wanawadanganya Israeli wafanye mkataba nao kwa kujifanya wametoka nchi ya mbali. Udanganyifu huo unapogunduliwa, wanaachwa hai lakini wanafanywa wakata kuni na wachota maji.
9.am: የገባዖን ሰዎች ከሩቅ አገር እንደ መጡ መስለው እስራኤልን በማታለል ውል እንዲገቡላቸው ያደርጋሉ። ማታለላቸው በታወቀ ጊዜ በሕይወት ይተርፋሉ፤ ነገር ግን እንጨት ቆራጮችና ውኃ ቀጂዎች ይደረጋሉ።

10.en: Five Amorite kings attack Gibeon, and Joshua comes to its aid; God throws them into panic and the sun stands still until Israel has won. Joshua then takes the cities of the south.
10.sw: Wafalme watano wa Waamori wanaishambulia Gibeoni, na Yoshua anakwenda kuisaidia; Mungu anawatia hofu kuu na jua linasimama mpaka Israeli washinde. Kisha Yoshua anaiteka miji ya kusini.
10.am: አምስት የአሞራውያን ነገሥታት ገባዖንን ይወጋሉ፤ ኢያሱም ሊረዳት ይመጣል፤ እግዚአብሔር ያሸብራቸዋል፤ እስራኤልም ድል እስኪያደርጉ ፀሐይ ትቆማለች። ከዚያም ኢያሱ የደቡቡን ከተሞች ይይዛል።

11.en: Joshua defeats a great alliance of northern kings at the waters of Merom and burns Hazor. Joshua takes the whole land, as God had told Moses, and the land has rest from war.
11.sw: Yoshua anaushinda muungano mkubwa wa wafalme wa kaskazini kwenye maji ya Meromu na kuuchoma moto Hazori. Yoshua anaiteka nchi yote, kama Mungu alivyokuwa amemwambia Musa, na nchi inapata pumziko kutoka vitani.
11.am: ኢያሱ በሜሮም ውኆች አጠገብ የሰሜንን ነገሥታት ታላቅ ኅብረት ድል ያደርጋል፤ አሶርንም በእሳት ያቃጥላል። እግዚአብሔር ለሙሴ እንደ ነገረው ኢያሱ ምድሪቱን ሁሉ ይይዛል፤ ምድሪቱም ከጦርነት ታርፋለች።

12.en: The kings Israel defeated are listed, both east of the Jordan under Moses and west of it under Joshua.
12.sw: Wafalme ambao Israeli waliwashinda wanaorodheshwa, wale wa mashariki ya Yordani chini ya Musa na wale wa magharibi yake chini ya Yoshua.
12.am: እስራኤል ድል ያደረጓቸው ነገሥታት ይዘረዘራሉ፤ በሙሴ ዘመን ከዮርዳኖስ በስተ ምሥራቅ፣ በኢያሱም ዘመን በስተ ምዕራቡ ያሉት።

13.en: God tells the aged Joshua that much land remains to be taken. The land east of the Jordan is described as Moses gave it to Reuben, Gad and half of Manasseh.
13.sw: Mungu anamwambia Yoshua, ambaye sasa ni mzee, kwamba bado kuna nchi nyingi ya kutekwa. Nchi iliyo mashariki ya Yordani inaelezwa kama Musa alivyowapa Reubeni, Gadi na nusu ya kabila la Manase.
13.am: እግዚአብሔር ያረጀውን ኢያሱን ገና ብዙ የሚወረስ ምድር እንደ ቀረ ይነግረዋል። ከዮርዳኖስ በስተ ምሥራቅ ያለው ምድር ሙሴ ለሮቤል፣ ለጋድና ለምናሴ ነገድ እኩሌታ እንደ ሰጠው ይገለጻል።

14.en: Caleb, now eighty-five, asks for the hill country promised to him, and Joshua gives him Hebron.
14.sw: Kalebu, ambaye sasa ana miaka themanini na mitano, anaomba nchi ya milima aliyoahidiwa, na Yoshua anampa Hebroni.
14.am: አሁን የሰማንያ አምስት ዓመት ሰው የሆነው ካሌብ ተስፋ የተሰጠውን ኮረብታማውን አገር ይጠይቃል፤ ኢያሱም ኬብሮንን ይሰጠዋል።

15.en: The borders and towns of the tribe of Judah are set out. Caleb drives the sons of Anak out of Hebron, and Othniel takes Debir and marries Caleb's daughter Achsah.
15.sw: Mipaka na miji ya kabila la Yuda inaelezwa. Kalebu anawafukuza wana wa Anaki kutoka Hebroni, na Othnieli anauteka Debiri na kumwoa Aksa binti ya Kalebu.
15.am: የይሁዳ ነገድ ድንበሮችና ከተሞች ይዘረዘራሉ። ካሌብ የዔናቅን ልጆች ከኬብሮን ያባርራል፤ ጎቶንያልም ዳቤርን ይይዛል፤ የካሌብንም ልጅ ዓክሳን ያገባል።

16.en: The inheritance of the descendants of Joseph is described, beginning with the borders of Ephraim.
16.sw: Urithi wa wazao wa Yusufu unaelezwa, ukianza na mipaka ya Efraimu.
16.am: የዮሴፍ ዘሮች ርስት ይገለጻል፤ በኤፍሬም ድንበሮችም ይጀምራል።

17.en: The inheritance of Manasseh is described, including the daughters of Zelophehad. The descendants of Joseph complain that they need more land, and Joshua tells them to clear the forested hill country.
17.sw: Urithi wa Manase unaelezwa, pamoja na binti za Selofehadi. Wazao wa Yusufu wanalalamika kwamba wanahitaji nchi zaidi, na Yoshua anawaambia waisafishe nchi ya milima yenye msitu.
17.am: የምናሴ ርስት ይገለጻል፤ የሰለጰዓድ ሴቶች ልጆችም በውስጡ ይጠቀሳሉ። የዮሴፍ ዘሮች ተጨማሪ ምድር እንደሚያስፈልጋቸው ያማርራሉ፤ ኢያሱም ዱር የሆነውን ኮረብታማ አገር እንዲመነጥሩ ይነግራቸዋል።

18.en: The tent of meeting is set up at Shiloh, and men are sent to survey the rest of the land. Lots are cast for seven tribes, beginning with Benjamin.
18.sw: Hema la Kukutania linasimamishwa huko Shilo, na watu wanatumwa kuipima nchi iliyobaki. Kura zinapigwa kwa ajili ya makabila saba, kuanzia na Benyamini.
18.am: የመገናኛው ድንኳን በሴሎ ይተከላል፤ የቀረውንም ምድር እንዲቃኙ ሰዎች ይላካሉ። ለሰባት ነገዶች ዕጣ ይጣላል፤ በብንያምም ይጀመራል።

19.en: The inheritances of Simeon, Zebulun, Issachar, Asher, Naphtali and Dan are given by lot, and Joshua receives a town of his own.
19.sw: Urithi wa Simeoni, Zabuloni, Isakari, Asheri, Naftali na Dani unatolewa kwa kura, na Yoshua anapokea mji wake mwenyewe.
19.am: የስምዖን፣ የዛብሎን፣ የይሳኮር፣ የአሴር፣ የንፍታሌምና የዳን ርስቶች በዕጣ ይሰጣሉ፤ ኢያሱም የራሱን ከተማ ይቀበላል።

20.en: Six cities of refuge are set apart for anyone who kills a person by accident.
20.sw: Miji sita ya makimbilio inatengwa kwa ajili ya mtu yeyote anayemuua mtu bila kukusudia.
20.am: ሳያስበው ሰውን ለገደለ ሰው ሁሉ ስድስት የመማጸኛ ከተሞች ይለያሉ።

21.en: The Levites are given forty-eight towns with pasturelands among the tribes. God has given Israel all the land promised to their ancestors, and not one promise has failed.
21.sw: Walawi wanapewa miji arobaini na minane pamoja na malisho yake kati ya makabila. Mungu amewapa Israeli nchi yote aliyowaahidi babu zao, wala hakuna hata ahadi moja iliyoshindwa.
21.am: ሌዋውያን በነገዶቹ መካከል አርባ ስምንት ከተሞችን ከመሰማሪያዎቻቸው ጋር ይቀበላሉ። እግዚአብሔር ለአባቶቻቸው የማለላቸውን ምድር ሁሉ ለእስራኤል ሰጥቷል፤ ከተስፋ ቃሉም አንዱ እንኳ አልቀረም።

22.en: The eastern tribes return home and build a large altar by the Jordan, and the other tribes prepare for war. The eastern tribes explain that it is a witness, not an altar for sacrifice, and peace is kept.
22.sw: Makabila ya mashariki yanarudi nyumbani na kujenga madhabahu kubwa karibu na Yordani, na makabila mengine yanajiandaa kwa vita. Makabila ya mashariki yanaeleza kwamba ni ushahidi, si madhabahu ya dhabihu, na amani inadumishwa.
22.am: የምሥራቅ ነገዶች ወደ ቤታቸው ይመለሳሉ፤ በዮርዳኖስ አጠገብም ታላቅ መሠዊያ ይሠራሉ፤ ሌሎቹ ነገዶች ለጦርነት ይዘጋጃሉ። የምሥራቅ ነገዶች መሠዊያው ለመሥዋዕት ሳይሆን ምስክር መሆኑን ያስረዳሉ፤ ሰላምም ይጠበቃል።

23.en: Joshua, old and near death, urges Israel's leaders to love God and keep the law, and warns them against marrying the nations that remain.
23.sw: Yoshua, ambaye ni mzee na karibu kufa, anawasihi viongozi wa Israeli wampende Mungu na kuishika sheria, na kuwaonya wasioane na mataifa yaliyobaki.
23.am: ያረጀውና ሞቱ የቀረበው ኢያሱ የእስራኤልን መሪዎች እግዚአብሔርን እንዲወዱና ሕጉን እንዲጠብቁ ያሳስባቸዋል፤ ከቀሩት አሕዛብ ጋርም እንዳይጋቡ ያስጠነቅቃቸዋል።

24.en: At Shechem Joshua recounts God's acts from Abraham to the conquest and calls the people to choose whom they will serve. The people renew the covenant, and Joshua dies and is buried, as are Joseph's bones and Eleazar.
24.sw: Huko Shekemu Yoshua anasimulia matendo ya Mungu kuanzia Abrahamu hadi kutekwa kwa nchi, na kuwaita watu wachague ni nani watakayemtumikia. Watu wanafanya upya agano, na Yoshua anakufa na kuzikwa, kama vile mifupa ya Yusufu na Eleazari pia.
24.am: በሴኬም ኢያሱ ከአብርሃም ጀምሮ ምድሪቱ እስከ ተያዘችበት ድረስ እግዚአብሔር ያደረገውን ይተርካል፤ ሕዝቡንም ማንን እንደሚያገለግሉ እንዲመርጡ ይጠራቸዋል። ሕዝቡ ቃል ኪዳኑን ያድሳሉ፤ ኢያሱ ይሞታል፤ ይቀበራልም፤ የዮሴፍ ዐፅምና አልዓዛርም እንዲሁ ይቀበራሉ።
